mechanics.claim: Leap deals damage to nearby enemies upon landing, in an area.
mechanics.quote: leaps to the target location, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies upon landing

mechanics.claim: Taste Their Fear (Q) can be cast during the dash.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|Taste Their Fear|Kha'Zix}} can be cast during the dash.''

mechanics.claim: Evolved Wings gives Leap increased cast range and resets its cooldown on scoring a champion takedown.
mechanics.quote: ''Leap'' gains 200 '''bonus''' cast range, and the {{sti|cooldown}} resets upon scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}}.
